searchText: For EIP-2930, hash data is set as `rlp([1, chainId, nonce, gasPrice, gasLimit, to, value, data, access_list])`, just wanted to check if it stays like this or is maybe going to be changed to something like `1 || rlp([chainId, nonce, gasPrice, gasLimit, to, value, data, access_list])`? <@429719902363058177> EIP was just updated today, it is the latter. Oh, wait. So the signed data is the first. The actual transaction is the latter, but with 3 more parameters (signature). Hmm, you bring up a good point though. I don't think the EIP specifies how to hash, nor receipt format. I am talking about data that is going to be hashes, without signature Once power comes back I'll fill those details in. It is this part of EIP `The signing hash would be the hash of the RLP of the entire data structure but popping the last three items representing the signature, and prepending the transaction type: rlp([1, chainId, nonce, gasPrice, gasLimit, to, value, data, access_list]).` Wording could use some love there, along with popping off signature, we also prepend with 1. Hashing for wire transmission and hashing for signature aren't over the same data. Hash for merklization is different from signing hash as well. Once I get power back I'll submit a PR to update the EIP with hashing scheme and receipt scheme.
